questions.q: How did Timmy Willie get to town?
choices: He rode all the way on the back of the cat
He fell asleep in a hamper of vegetables
He walked along the road for many miles
Johnny Town-mouse came and fetched him
questions.evidence: went to town by mistake in a hamper

questions.q: What did Timmy Willie eat in the hamper before he fell asleep?
choices: Some peas
A cabbage leaf
Some corn seeds
A bit of cake

questions.q: What did the cook do when Timmy Willie sprang out of the hamper?
choices: Caught him in her apron and shook him
Jumped on a chair and called for the cat
Gave him a crumb of cake and some cheese
Put him back in the hamper and shut the lid
questions.evidence: Up jumped the cook on a chair

questions.q: What did Timmy Willie crash into when he dropped through the hole?
choices: A mouse dinner party
The coal-cellar
A box of sugar
The cat's basket
questions.evidence: crashed into the middle of a mouse dinner party

questions.q: Why did Timmy Willie lose his appetite at the dinner party?
choices: The food was much too strange and sweet for him to eat
He found out the young mice were chased by the cat
He had eaten too many peas in the hamper
The other mice laughed at his short tail
questions.evidence: Timmy Willie learnt with horror that they were being chased by the cat

questions.q: Why did Timmy Willie not sleep on the sofa pillow?
choices: It smelt of cat
It was too hard and lumpy for him
It was kept only for Johnny
It was wet from the rain outside
questions.evidence: But the sofa smelt of cat.

questions.q: How did Timmy Willie feel while he stayed in town?
choices: Happy and full of fun
Homesick and ill
Brave and proud
Bored but well fed
questions.evidence: Timmy Willie longed to be at home in his peaceful nest in a sunny bank.

questions.q: When did Johnny Town-mouse come to visit the country?
choices: On a snowy day in winter
In the spring, when the sun came out
In the autumn when the corn was ripe
On Christmas Eve with a present
questions.evidence: The winter passed; the sun came out again

questions.q: Why did Johnny Town-mouse go back to town?
choices: The big cows frightened him far away
He said the country was too quiet
His friends sent him a letter
Timmy Willie asked him to leave
questions.evidence: he said it was too quiet!!

questions.q: What is the lesson of this story?
choices: The town is always better than the country
Mice should never ride in a vegetable hamper
One place suits one person, another suits another
Always be careful when a cat is in the house
questions.evidence: One place suits one person, another place suits another person.
